play.offer_line: [{n}] {tier}: build {capexUsd} · rent {rentUsd}/quarter · power {powerPct} of the usual price
play.help:
Commands:
  buy <machine#> <count> [used] [site#]  e.g. "buy 1 2" or "buy 3 1 used 2" (site 1 if left out)
  sell <batch#> <count>                  sell at the used price
  repair <batch#>                        fix broken units
  hodl <0-100>                           % of mined coins to keep instead of selling
  scout <tier>                           e.g. "scout warehouse" (1 Bandwidth)
  build <offer#> or build <tier>         e.g. "build 1" or "build small_unit" (1 Bandwidth)
  end                                    start the live quarter
  look                                   show the full Plan screen again
  help · quit
